extras: Uses external libraries (Flint and Apache ECharts) for rendering.
intentEvidence: Flint treats meaning as a first-class input, so it can derive the low-level decisions instead of asking you for them.
motivation: To treat meaning as a first-class input, allowing the plugin to derive low-level visualization decisions instead of requiring manual configuration.
problem: Manually configuring complex data visualizations is difficult because chart grammars often conflict with the actual meaning of the data.
summary: A semantic chart rendering plugin that uses Flint to generate and display 37 types of charts based on data meaning and chart type declaration.
